items.name: Armstrong's Chamois
items.description: This soft chamois was gifted to Kelpie on the evening of May 8, 406 PR. Swiping it across a slashing, bludgeoning, or piercing weapon grants that weapon +1 to hit and +1 damage on its next attack within 24 hours. A weapon can benefit only once per 24 hours. Each use requires a usage-die roll; a result of 1 or 2 steps the die down from its initial d20, and the magic is exhausted when that result is rolled on a d4.
items.provenance: Created by Samuel Armstrong during a 36-day imbuing process begun March 2, 406 PR.
